why: Five of twelve results are blank RV manuals/brochures or a 404, one is a Reddit fridge thread, two are recycled affiliate copies of the same LincStation review, and one is a rackmount NAS review. The only major reviewer (ServeTheHome) reviews a single 12V-input mini NAS without the van/power-budget framing, and the only page that actually addresses 12V-native NAS (IMD knowledge base) is a DIY SBC build guide from a vendor, not a product comparison. No major reviewer or authority answers 'which NAS runs straight off 12 V and what does it draw'. A focused page listing 12V-barrel NAS models (CWWK/Topton mini NAS, LincStation, Pi/Helios builds), their rated and measured draw, voltage tolerance and prices would stand out.
